summary: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a common shares purchase agreement with Gold King Arthur Holding Limited. The company agreed to sell up to $50 million of common stock, capped at 19.99% of pre-transaction voting power unless shareholder approval is obtained. The purchase price equals 93% of the lowest daily VWAP over three consecutive trading days. The offering is exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). Proceeds will be used as described in the company's registration statement. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The transaction is structured as a private placement with ongoing VWAP-based purchases. What to watch: shareholder approval for exceeding the exchange cap and utilization of the draw fee.
